title: Midnight Skip
description: A nocturnal, percussion-led 2-step roller: a busy broken-707 shuffle skips under off-beat dub organ stabs, a sidechained pad breathes against the kick, and a chopped diva vocal flickers through the dark. It opens stripped and filtered, layers up through hats, sub and vocal chops, drops to a pad-led breakdown, then peaks before stripping back to the shuffle.
